title: Stellantis CEO reconfirms 2026 guidance, says turnaround plan continues as automaker's shares hit new low
summary_full: Stellantis CEO Antonio Filosa on Wednesday reconfirmed the company's 2026 guidance and its plans to be cash-flow positive by 2027.
